title: A Soft Answer Turns Away Wrath

questions.question: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:1 (ESV): "but a harsh word stirs up anger."

questions.question: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:3 (ESV): "keeping watch on the evil and the good."

questions.question: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but perverseness in it breaks the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:4 (ESV): "but perverseness in it breaks the spirit."

questions.question: A fool despises his father's instruction, but whoever heeds reproof is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:5 (ESV): "but whoever heeds reproof is prudent."

questions.question: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is than a fattened ox and what with it?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:17 (ESV): "than a fattened ox and hatred with it."

questions.question: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord, but the prayer of the upright is his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:8 (ESV): "but the prayer of the upright is his delight."

questions.question: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but by sorrow of heart the spirit is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:13 (ESV): "but by sorrow of heart the spirit is crushed."

questions.question: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:22 (ESV): "but with many advisers they succeed."

questions.question: The Lord tears down the house of the proud but maintains the widow's what?
The fear of the Lord is instruction in wisdom, and humility comes before what?
Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the Lord; how much more the hearts of the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:11 (ESV): "how much more the hearts of the children of man!"

questions.question: The way of the sluggard is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:19 (ESV): "but the path of the upright is a level highway."

questions.question: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord, but gracious words are what?
Whoever is greedy for unjust gain troubles his own household, but he who hates bribes will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:27 (ESV): "but he who hates bribes will live."

questions.question: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, and good news refreshes the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:30 (ESV): "and good news refreshes the bones."

key_verse_text: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
